notes: AMBIA-LINE steel drawer frames and cutlery inserts for LEGRABOX and MERIVOBOX drawers (heights M and K) from the Blum Catalogue and technical manual 2024/2025, printed pages 544 (order information) and 546 (recommendation by cabinet width KB and nominal length NL). The recommendation tables give item counts by KB; between printed widths the next narrower row applies. Wood design pieces (p.545) take the same recommendation; p.545 prints no adapter profile for them. High fronted pull-outs (pp. 547-551) are not recorded. Not verified by a person.
